notes: The supplied event export spans 6 months, so these are whole-file overlap counts, not same-month reliability estimates. The roster has update/as-of dates rather than an explicit reporting month. Counts use distinct trimmed roster names after removing trailing status annotations, exclude schedule/summary rows and include all client-name columns in all nine tables. Distinct Excel name strings remain distinct candidates even if they normalize identically. Exact, normalized, nickname/prefix, then surname-typo tiers are applied in order; more than one candidate at the strongest available tier is ambiguous. Nicknames use a finite common-nickname list. A non-match does not establish that a person had no events in a particular month.
